People also ask
Is GEO replacing SEO?
AI Overview

AI Mode replied:

No, GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) is not replacing SEO (Search Engine Optimization); rather, it expands and builds upon it. 
The Relationship Between GEO and SEO
  • SEO focuses on optimizing your website so it ranks higher in traditional search engine results pages (SERPs) and drives direct clicks to your site. 
  • GEO focuses on making your brand, content, and data legible, credible, and structured so that AI tools (like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews) pull from your site and cite or recommend you in generated answers. 
  • The Foundation: Good SEO is a mandatory prerequisite for good GEO. If your site lacks technical health, crawlability, indexing, and topical authority, AI models will not find or trust your content. 
Key Differences at a Glance
FeatureTraditional SEOGenerative Engine Optimization (GEO)
Primary GoalRank on search engines & earn clicksGet cited or recommended inside AI answers
Primary MetricKeyword rankings, click-through rate (CTR), organic trafficCitation frequency, brand share of voice, AI mentions
Target OutputA blue link on a search results pageA synthesized, conversational summary or recommendation
Why You Need Both
As conversational search and zero-click AI summaries grow
, users increasingly gather research directly inside AI platforms before ever visiting a traditional website. However, those same AI engines rely heavily on established web authority, clear site structure, and existing organic footprints to decide which sources are reliable enough to cite. 
You can read more about how AI search is transforming digital strategy via the California Management Review or explore implementation insights from Forbes and Otterly.ai.
